features: 【Fast Transfer Speed】Enjoy Lightning-Fast File Transfers With USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C, Offering Speeds Of Up To 10Gbps For Quick Access To Your Data And Blazing Performance.
【Sturdy Build】Constructed With A Durable Metal Body, This Enclosure Provides Superior Protection For Your SSD While Enhancing Heat Dissipation For Reliable Performance.
【SSD Form Factors】Compatible With 2230, 2242, 2260, And 2280 M.2 NVMe PCIe SSDs, Offering Flexible Storage Options To Meet Your Needs. (NGFF Not Supported)
【Storage Capacity】Supports High-Capacity SSDs Up To 4TB, Allowing You To Store Large Files, Games, And Media Without Worry.
【Plug and Play】No Drivers Or Software Needed, Simply Connect Your SSD And Start Using It Immediately For A Hassle Free Experience.
【Compact & Portable】Lightweight And Sleek Design Makes It Easy To Carry, Allowing You To Take Your Data On The Go Wherever You Need It.
【Wide Compatibility】Fully Supports Windows, Mac, Linux, And Android, Ensuring Seamless Performance Across A Variety Of Devices And Operating Systems.
